@copilot 评估是否已经完成了任务中要求和所有开发，并且已经集成到console 控制台中？

> @copilot 评估是否已经完成了任务中要求和所有开发，并且已经集成到console 控制台中？

The floating chatbot is now integrated into the console application in commit `219ff3f`.

**What was done:**
- **Plugin layer** (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`): `FloatingChatbot`, `FloatingChatbotPanel`, `FloatingChatbotTrigger`, `FloatingChatbotProvider` components + `useFloatingChatbot` hook + `chatbot-floating` ComponentRegistry entry + 21 tests
- **Types** (`@object-ui/types`): `ChatbotSchema.displayMode` + `FloatingChatbotConfig` interface
- **Console integration** (`apps/console/src/components/ConsoleLayout.tsx`): Added `ConsoleFloatingChatbot` using `useObjectChat` — the FAB appears on every authenticated page with metadata-aware context (app name and object list injected into auto-responses)

**Remaining items not yet implemented** (could be follow-up issues):
- Drag-to-reposition panel
- Panel conversation history button
- Storybook stories
- Full documentation page
